text:
Sam: Heads-up — final preflight for prod push tonight 23:00 UTC. Service: inference-api. Change window 23:00–23:30 UTC. Runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploy-backout-v2. Quick bullets: abort triggers = error rate spike >1.5% sustained 5m, p95 latency >600ms, any quality regression on the canary eval set, or failing healthchecks. We'll pin new image tag release-2024-05-06 to canary hosts and keep fallback tag release-2024-05-04 ready.

Priya: Copy. Who's primary for rollback actions if canary trips? @Ben are you oncall tonight?

Ben: I am oncall. If we need to abort do this (runbook has full details):
```
deploy-bot abort --service=inference-api --version=release-2024-05-06
deploy-bot pin --service=inference-api --version=release-2024-05-04
```
I'll also coordinate rolling back traffic and confirm pins.

Maria: Small preflight note — disable cache warmers for the canary window (runbook §2). Cold starts will spike p95 otherwise.

deploy-bot: preflight check summary: smoke tests ✅, canary infra slots available ✅, dependents check ✅. All green for 23:00 canary.

Sam: Plan: 10% for 15m -> 50% for 10m -> full. Canary auto-abort enabled with same abort triggers above. If the auto-abort fails to revert traffic, Ben will run manual steps. We'll keep the release notes and changelog handy.

Jamie: Where are the release notes (PR link)?

Sam: https://git.redwood/repo/releases/pull/412 — note the model quant change and the optimized kernel flag; see the "rollout notes" section.

Priya: I'll wire an alert to #incidents for the key metric thresholds and add a small alert to the paging policy so we get notified immediately.

Ben: If abort required and deploy-bot is unresponsive, fallback manual commands in runbook (copying one here):
```
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/inference-api
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/inference-api inference-api=registry.redwood/release-2024-05-04
```
I'll ping ops-sev2 and confirm once done.

oncall-bot: Pager: Ben is primary oncall (phone icon).

Sam: Final checks: my phone is on. Priya, Maria — please keep an eye on canary eval dashboards. If everything stays green we'll tag release-prod in the dashboard at 23:32. :thumbsup:
